title: Cisco ISE Device Compliance & Posture Integration with Intune (MDM Compliance Connector)
hook: Let Cisco ISE gate network access on Intune device compliance
problem: A device can hold a valid certificate and still be non-compliant — unencrypted, out of date, jailbroken. This solution wires Cisco ISE to Microsoft Intune through the MDM compliance connector so ISE queries each device's real-time enrollment and compliance state and gates VPN and network access on it — the posture / NAC piece that turns compliance policy into enforced access, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how ISE-to-Intune posture works: the Entra app registration ISE uses, the MDM compliance connection, the compliance and enrollment signals ISE reads, and how they map to authorization / access rules.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune compliance policies in place, an Entra app registration with the right Graph permissions, ISE licensing/version for MDM, network reachability, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to register the app in Entra, connect ISE to Intune, define named compliance policies, map them to ISE authorization, assign to a pilot, and validate that non-compliant devices are denied, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — connector-readiness discovery, per-device compliance/enrollment validation, a compliance-coverage and access-decision report, safe remediation of non-compliant devices, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates (registered, compliant, access granted; non-compliant, access denied), plus Best Practices for grace and remediation.
short: Wire Cisco ISE to Intune via the MDM compliance connector so ISE gates VPN and network access on real-time device compliance and enrollment — the posture/NAC layer, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Wire Cisco ISE to Intune via the MDM compliance connector so ISE gates VPN and network access on real-time device compliance and enrollment — the posture/NAC layer, pilot-first.
